2363-4030-4659-5224.description:
Cast Hangarback Walker by paying {1} due to Starnheim Courser, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Hangarback Walker.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Hangarback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Hangarback Walker dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Hangarback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

618-3817-4050.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, targeting Sister Hospitaller
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki
Resolve the Kiki-Jiki ability, creating a token copy of Sister Hospitaller with haste.
When the Sister Hospitaller token enters, it triggers, returning Kiki-JIki from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life
Repeat.

2557-4772-6664-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

775-1409-7824.description:
Activate Jewel Thief by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Jewel Thief enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Jewel Thief.
Resolve the Jewel Thief trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

967-3809-6797-7087-7824.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

1409-3099-4289-7296.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

1368-5477-6321-7297.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-5477-6321-7297.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

719-2511-4302.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
719-2511-4302.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Xenograft, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

2079-4149-4599-4871-6019.description:
Activate Ghoulcaller Gisa by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing Scourge of Nel Toth.
When Scourge of Nel Toth dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ghoulcaller Gisa ability, creating six 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Scourge of Nel Toth from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} and sacrificing a Zombie token and Ghoulcaller Gisa.
When the Zombie and Ghoulcaller Gisa die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve Scourge of Nel Toth.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping Scourge of Nel Toth and four other Zombies, returning Ghoulcaller GIsa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1869-2034-2120.notablePrerequisites: Opponents are unable to block Wanderwine prophets.
1869-2034-2120.description:
Cast Wanderwine Prophets by paying {4}{U}{U}.
Wanderwine Prophets enters the battlefield, triggering its champion ability and Inalla.
Resolve the Inalla trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Wanderwine Prophets with haste.
The token Wanderwine Prophets enters the battlefield, championing the nontoken Wanderwine Prophets.
The nontoken Wanderwine Prophets leaves the battlefield, returning nothing from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the nontoken Wanderwine Prophets trigger from step 2, choosing not to exile anything.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Mistbind Clique token, adding at least one mana.
The Wanderwine Prophets token leaves the battlefield, returning the nontoken Wanderwine Prophets from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 until satisfied.
When the nontoken wanderwine Prophets enters the battlefield, it triggers Inalla and Wanderwine Prophets.
Resolve Inalla's trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Wanderwine Prophets.
Token copy of Wanderwine Prophets enters the battlefield, championing original Wanderwine Prophets.
Resolve the Wanderwine Prophets trigger, does nothing.
Move to combat.
Declare token copy of Wanderwine Prophets as attacker.
Deal combat damage with Wanderwine Prophets.
Token copy of Wanderwine Prophets triggers, causing you to sacrifice itself and take an extra turn after this one.
Token copy of Wanderwine Prophets leaves the battlefield, returning Wanderwine Prophets to the battlefield from exile.
Repeat step 2 to 5.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat from step 14.

323-4050-4681-5170.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Falkenrath Noble triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Falkenrath Noble trigger.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1414-2854-4574-5849.easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1414-2854-4574-5849.description:
Cast Lotus Petal either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Lotus Petal from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

132-2816-3053.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three basic land types among lands you control
132-2816-3053.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Prismatic Geoscope's ability by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Myr Welder by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1170-1492-3200-6862.easyPrerequisites: One of the artifacts must be in your hand, while the other is either in your graveyard or in your library.
1170-1492-3200-6862.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1170-1492-3200-6862.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Delivery Moogle.
When Delivery Moogle enters, it triggers, searching your library or graveyard for the other artifact and putting it into your hand.
Activate the artifact cast in step 1 by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1395-1987-4087-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Lavabrink Floodgates by tapping them, adding {U}{R}{R}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}.
Elsha's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve Ghostly Flicker, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Lavabrink Floodgates
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

63-1651-4013-4131.description:
Activate Basalt Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Wernog.
When Wernog leaves and enters, it triggers twice, creating at least two Clue tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Clues, untapping Basalt Monolith.
Repeat.
63-1651-4013-4131.notes: Because your opponents must choose to either let themselves and you investigate, or lose life, this combo will very likely result in infinite Clue tokens for you and your opponents.

292-1495-3334.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Triskelion.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
292-1495-3334.notes: You can remove counters to deal damage to creatures you control, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on them due to Rite of Passage.

requires.n: Creature with MV=1 and Creates Creature Token(s) on Death

413-2178-6542--110.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with mana value 0.
413-2178-6542--110.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with mana value 0.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning the creature that creates creature token(s) on death from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature.
When the creature dies, it and Sidisi trigger.
Resolve the Sidisi trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the creature's trigger, creating at least one creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5.
Repeat.

1020-2146-2866-6518.description:
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Scrap Trawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

148-6428.notablePrerequisites: You have more cards in hand than your maximum hand size.
148-6428.description:
During the next cleanup step, discard cards down to your maximum hand size.
Magmakin Artillerist triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent for each card discarded this way.
Keen Sense triggers, causing you to draw a card.
As you are still in the cleanup step, once the stack is empty and priority has been passed by all players, you will discard down to your maximum hand size again.
Repeat from step 2.

5276-5686-6412.description:
Cast Leonin Relic-Warder by paying {W}{W}.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Pre-War Formalwear.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Leonin Relic-Warder.
When Leonin Relic-Warder dies, its second ability triggers, returning Pre-War Formalwear from exile to the battlefield.
When Pre-War Formalwear enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Leonin Relic-Warder from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Pre-War Formalwear to it.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Pre-War Formalwear.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 3.
Repeat from step 3.

4772-5435-5742-5743.description:
Activate Dream Trawler by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Dream Trawler ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1432-2872-4639.notablePrerequisites: Clever Conjurer and Ioreth of the Healing House do not have summoning sickness.
1432-2872-4639.description:
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, targeting Ioreth of the Healing House.
Clever Conjurer triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Clever Conjurer ability, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, targeting Clever Conjurer.
Ioreth of the Healing House triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Ioreth of the Healing House ability, untapping Clever Conjurer.
Repeat.

997-2281-6125.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Fiendish Panda.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Fiendish Panda.
When Fiendish Panda dies, its second ability and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Fiendish Panda from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Fiendish Panda trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

803-997-1238-2351-5467.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Wight of the Reliquary

2178-3703-5627.easyPrerequisites: Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.
2178-3703-5627.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2178-3703-5627.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Wight of the Reliquary triggers, untapping Wight of the Reliquary.
Resolve the Wight of the Reliquary ability from step 1, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Sporemound triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

678-2932-5284.description:
Activate Blood Vassal by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
When Blood Vassal dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Blood Vassal from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Blood Vassal by paying {1}{B}.
Bontu's Monument triggers, causing each opponent to lose one life and you to gain one life.
Repeat.

1545-4050-4399-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {1} and either {W} or two life.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
The Soldier enters the battlefield, triggering Trostani, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher, causing it to enter the battlefield, triggering itself and Trostani.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Trostani trigger, causing you to gain three life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Spirit token, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3000-4871.description:
Activate Chatterfang by paying {B} and sacrificing another Squirrel.
When the Squirrel dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
Resolve all Chatterfang abilities, causing any number of target creatures to get +1/-1 until end of turn any number of times.
3000-4871.notes: If you control additional Squirrels, you can sacrifice them as well to get infinite Treasure tokens.
